title: Daytime Sailing Along San Diego's Skyline
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Reach out to Viator directly for amendments and cancellations
Our office hours are 12 p.m. until the sunset sail departs. Leave us a voice or text message outside of those hours and we'll get back to you.
Each person regardless of age MUST have a paid ticket due to strict Coast Guard regulations. Extra person's regardless of age that arrive and put us over our passenger limit will be denied boarding.
Be sure to follow the link under "Special Instructions" on your Viator ticket after booking for a detailed map, photos, directions & video of our meeting point.
Refunds will not be issued if tour/activity is missed due to late or non-arrival of cruise ship or flight
Children must be accompanied by an adult

When combining reservations, each out to us directly We will do our best to accommodate pairing up mixed groups, but may not be able to due to strict Coast Guard regulations regarding passenger capacity per boat.
We sail as scheduled in the event of light rain.
We are located at Safeharbor Sunroad Marina, 945 Harbor Island Dr. San Diego, CA 92109. We will meet at Gate 1 Docks A-D
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Set sail with your Captain aboard our sail yacht and see some of San Diego's finest highlights on thisfamily-friendly sailing experience. We'll set sail from Safeharbor Sunroad Marina on Harbor Island on San Diego Bay, we often see Sea Lions and occasionally Dolphins frolicking, and we always have a fantastic time! White wine, soda, water are available on board complimentary

For a private sailing experience for you and your friends only, feel free to book all 6 seats

If you don't see a date scheduled that your interested in, reach out! We sail daily and can usually accommodate you!

Other things to note
Smoking is not permitted on board.
